judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names and type names entirely: it used `list_sessions` and `session_list` (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `sessions`) instead of the issue's explicitly specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `conversations`). It completely omitted the required `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag (making the feature always-on by default, violating a core security/GDPR requirement). In `validation.ts`, it allows `limit: 0` and unbounded limits instead of enforcing the specified integer range of 1–200. Furthermore, `specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md` has a broken spec citation pointing to a renamed test title (`answers an empty session_list...` vs `answers UNSUPPORTED...`), and updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md` were completely skipped.
